requested_import_capacity_mw.claimant: None — Screening Report reportedly gives no power demand figure
requested_import_capacity_mw.notes: The Bell briefing states the applicant's EIA Screening Report 'mentions two SPEN grid connection offers' but 'provides no details of the scale of power demand from the data centre'.

evidence_basis: Secondary only: two SPEN grid connection offers referenced in the applicant's EIA Screening Report as summarised in the Simon Bell briefing (2025-11-28). The Screening Report itself has not been located, and no NESO/TEC register entry has been matched to this project. The proposed development includes new on-site substation(s) per the council scoping opinion. The site is roughly 6 km west of Torness power station and its 400 kV connection point, but no source links the project to Torness infrastructure — treat any such link as unverified.
notes: Connection status 'offer' is based solely on the reported reference to two SPEN connection offers; voltage, capacity, connection date and substation are all unknown.
